sqweezy.title: De slimme compactor die het leven thuis verandert
sqweezy.compatText: Compatible with all sizes of aluminium cans and plastic bottles up to 2.5L.
sqweezy.prob1: Recycling bags are expensive and always full
sqweezy.prob2: Bins overflow long before collection day
sqweezy.sol1: One foot press compacts each bottle or can in one second.
sqweezy.sol2: No electricity, no mounting: perfect for sailors and campers.
sqweezy.sol3: Easy for the whole family, children included.
sqweezy.virt3Desc: Stable and safe, no pinching possible
sqweezy.virt5Desc: Kids love it: sorting becomes a game
sqweezy.priceNote: €3 deducted from balance · Refunded if unshipped
